basic_info.description: Remodeled top-floor condo nestled in a prime Noe Valley location, steps to the 24th Street corridor with cafes, restaurants, public transportation/tech bus routes, and essential stops for everyday errands. This lovely unit maintains original charm and features a classic double parlor living room with green outlooks and a gas starter fireplace. Adjacent is a dining room with multiple windows overlooking the green garden. A bright, modern kitchen is thoughtfully designed with abundant storage, a smart layout, and a skylight letting in all-day light. The main level also hosts a bedroom, updated full bath, and in-unit laundry. The lower level offers two bedrooms and two en-suite bathrooms with great storage. Off the primary bedroom is a access to the shared garden . Additionally, there is a large attic for storage.
